description: This is a modern, minimalist wardrobe with a light beige finish. It features a clean, rectangular design with two tall doors on the upper half and two drawers on the lower half. Each door and drawer is accented with a single, round, dark blue knob. The wardrobe stands on a flat base and casts a subtle shadow to its right, indicating it is lit from the left. The simple form and neutral color make it a versatile piece of furniture suitable for various bedroom styles.
